title: BnoteV2
description: Advanced Banknote Plugin - Convert money to tradeable items with stacking, PlaceholderAPI, and CoreProtect support
body: BnoteV2 is a powerful and secure banknote plugin designed for modern Minecraft servers running Paper 1.21.7 or newer. It enables players to convert their in-game currency into physical, tradeable banknote items, making economy management seamless and interactive. Whether you're running a survival server, a shop-based economy, or a large network, BnoteV2 integrates perfectly with popular plugins like Vault, Essentials, and PlaceholderAPI. Players can withdraw money as stackable banknotes, deposit them with a simple right-click, or shift-click to redeem all at once. Admins benefit from robust permissions, configurable limits, and full transaction logging via CoreProtect. With built-in security using PersistentDataContainer (PDC), crafting and renaming exploits are fully prevented. Customize the banknote's appearance, sounds, and messages to match your server's theme. Ideal for player-to-player trading, admin rewards, or custom shop systems.
